items.description: Locate the leak and open the bathroom wall
items.rationale: The split internal supply pipe is an insured peril under §1.1, and §2.1 covers both leak location and wall opening. Two hours at €90 gross per hour total €180.

items.description: Replace split 15 mm copper pipe section and fittings
items.rationale: Section 2.2 covers repair of the fractured pipe. A gross allowance of €185 for labour, the short copper section and standard fittings is consistent with the comparable repair in Case 21.

items.description: Close, re-plaster and re-tile the 0.2 m² wall patch
items.rationale: Sections 2.1 and 2.3 cover closing the opening and restoring plaster and tiles to their previous condition. Allow €200 gross for small-job labour and matching materials, limited to the invoiced patch.
Section 3.1 expressly excludes servicing and descaling even during the same visit, and the boiler work was unrelated to the leak. The €220 gross estimate is conditional only; no payment is expected.
